root.label: BBC investigation of Athena disciplinary practices

events.label: BBC investigation of Athena disciplinary practices

slots.name: toilet restriction minutes
slots.sentence: Pupils were not allowed to go to the toilet in the first or last 15 minutes of a lesson, and were only allowed to go in the middle of a lesson at the teacher's discretion, pupils and former teachers told us.

slots.name: discipline strikes
slots.sentence: Athena schools have a two-strike policy: a warning for one mistake, sent out of the class for the second.

slots.name: Panorama interviewees
slots.sentence: BBC Panorama has spoken to nearly 100 pupils, parents and former teachers from Athena schools, who say levels of discipline went too far.

slots.name: secondary schools share
slots.sentence: There are no academy trusts in Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland, but more than 80% of secondary schools in England are now run by them.
